section_path: Accreditation Evidence — Adult Sepsis Recognition and Response
chunks.text:
Evidence prepared in support of 45 CFR 164.312 — technical safeguards for electronic
protected health information.

The organisation demonstrates compliance through clinical policy CP-POL-300 and the
associated Adult Sepsis Recognition and Response pathway (CP-SEPSIS-01).

Sampled records show that review the medication list against the reconciliation record was
performed before the next scheduled medication round in the majority of eligible episodes.
The reported measure is the proportion of eligible patients with the assessment completed on
time.

Gaps identified during the internal survey are tracked to closure by the Care Pathway Owner.

chunks.text:
Internal clinical audit of the Adult Sepsis Recognition and Response pathway (CP-SEPSIS-01).

Observation: in a sample of records, a documented early warning score above the escalation
threshold was present without a documented response, contrary to clinical policy CP-POL-300
and pathway CP-SEPSIS-01. Procedure reference: SOP-CLIN-278.

Standard: 45 CFR 164.308 — administrative safeguards and workforce access management.

Required action: reinforce that staff must refer to the specialist team using the standard
referral pathway within 24 hours of admission, and re-audit at the next cycle. Owner:
Director of Nursing Practice.

the record within 60 minutes of recognition, and re-audit at the next cycle. Owner: Pharmacy
